criteria.reason: Concrete, fair chairing: agenda, ground rules, speaker list, equal time for both sides, warning-then-withdrawal for disruptors, synthesis and vote.
Stays neutral on the hall; frames president as facilitator, presents both sides' arguments without endorsing either.
Not Rumantsch Grischun; macaronic Italian-dominant text with a stray Korean character fails linguistic accommodation.
Defers to communal statute but asserts an unsourced 1/5 secret-ballot threshold, partly inventing procedure.

factual_errors: Omits priority for speakers who have not yet spoken
summary: Substantively strong, neutral chairing guidance, but delivered in garbled Italian-pseudo-Romansh rather than Rumantsch Grischun, with an unsourced voting rule and no priority for first-time speakers.
